Book Title: The Year of the Perfect Christmas Tree: An Appalachian Story (Picture Puffin Books)
Author: Gloria Houston, Barbara Cooney
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Holidays & Celebrations > Christmas
Summary: This unforgettable tale, illustrated by Caldecott Medalist Barbara Cooney, has become a seasonal classic-a touching and joyful story about courage and the power of family.
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find this book to be an excellent Christmas story, with beautiful illustrations and a gentle expression of caring and love that serves as a great reminder of what matters most during the holiday season. Moreover, the book is wonderful for any age, with one customer noting it provides great information about Appalachian Mountains culture. However, several customers mention that the book is long for younger readers.

Book Title: The Polar Bear Son: An Inuit Tale
Author: Lydia Dabcovich
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Geography & Cultures > Multicultural Stories > Native North & South Americans
Summary: A lonely old woman adopts, cares for, and raises a polar bear as if he were her own son in this retelling of a traditional Inuit folktale. When jealous villagers threaten the bear's life, he is forced to leave his home and his "mother." "The story gives a picture of motherly love toward an 'adopted child,' one the woman will love always. Heartwarming." — School Library Journal
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find this book heartwarming with beautiful illustrations, making it a great resource for teaching children about other cultures. Moreover, they appreciate its value, with one customer noting it conveys real values through its tale of reciprocity and compassion.
